events.title: Jennifer Lopez turns 57
events.blurb: Multi-talented superstar Jennifer Lopez celebrates her 57th birthday today, born in The Bronx, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: J.Lo's Legacy
angles.copy: From Fly Girl to global icon, Jennifer Lopez turns 57 today! What's your all-time favourite J.Lo track?

events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Rolling Stones frontman and rock legend Mick Jagger celebrates his 83rd birthday today, born in Dartford, Kent, in 1943.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Royalty
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still commanding the stage! Happy Birthday to the one and only Mick Jagger.

events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) first launched in the USA on this day in 1981, famously kicking off with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star'.

angles.name: MTV Changed Everything
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV hit the airwaves and changed music forever. Remember the first video they played?

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on this day in 1994, featuring classics like 'Live Forever' and 'Supersonic'.

angles.name: Britpop Milestone
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and redefined a generation. What's your standout track from the album?

events.title: Woodstock Festival began 57 years ago
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, billed as '3 Days of Peace & Music', kicked off on this day in 1969 in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the iconic Woodstock festival began. A moment in history that truly captured the spirit of a generation.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley, 49 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 49 years since the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who died in Memphis, Tennessee, in 1977.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today, we lost a true icon. The music of Elvis Presley lives on, forever the King.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, 56 years on
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, leaving an indelible mark on music history.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost the extraordinary Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969, featuring the iconic zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history!

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today, born in Akron, Ohio, in 1951.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon and the voice of The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today, born in Manchester, England, in 1972.

angles.name: Mad For It
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single on this day in the U.S. in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: The first iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music on the go.

angles.name: Music In Your Pocket
angles.copy: A quarter-century ago, the original iPod dropped and changed the game. Remember your first one?

events.title: It's James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today is James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and vision of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy icon John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today, born in Weston-super-Mare in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: The White Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. So many classic tracks packed into one iconic release!
